irene: Hey team — my PR #3822 is hitting the CI typecheck + format gate. mypy + pyright errors and rustfmt on the go service. Can someone quick triage? I'm blocked on merging.
ci-bot: CI failed — jobs: typecheck, js-build, gofmt. Full run: https://ci.internal/runs/4589 (artifacts attached)
sam: I'll take a look in ~20m, pinging @max and @jules in case they're around earlier.
max: quick Q — does `pre-commit run --all-files` reproduce locally for you?
irene: Yes, repros locally. mypy error snippet:```
server/handlers.py:142: error: Item "None" of "Optional[str]" has no attribute "split"
```
jules: sounds like a missing None guard after parse_q. Which function?
irene: `parse_q` in handlers.py, signature is `def parse_q(s: Optional[str]) -> List[str]:` I probably assumed non-None later.
max: pyright is also failing in a different package:```
src/lib/cache.ts:47:8 - error TS2339: Property 'entries' does not exist on type 'Maybe<Record<string, any>>'
```
sam: hmm two different type systems flaking. Could be a shared-typing change or typeshed update. Any recent dep bumps in this PR?
irene: I didn't change types package. I just adjusted handler logic and added a small go change.
devops: Rerun queued for that job -> triggered rerun 4590.
ci-bot: Rerun finished — typecheck still fails, js-build fails same way, gofmt failing with format diff in `go/service/main.go`. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/4590/artifacts
sam: gofmt diffs are usually tiny. Paste `git diff` or the snippet?
irene: diff from artifact:```
- go func Foo() {
-     fmt.Println("x")
- }
+ func Foo() {
+     fmt.Println("x")
+ }
```
max: that's just a stray space/newline change, `gofmt -w` should fix.
jules: for the TS error, try running `yarn build` in `packages/shared-typing` or check the generated types. Maybe a `Maybe<T>` alias changed to `T | null` causing `.entries` to be unavailable.
sam: if local fixes don't resolve both, we may bisect the last green. Can someone run a quick bisect on CI or narrow last green commit?
irene: I kicked off a local bisect as well — looks suspiciously tied to commit `f3a9b2c` (shared-typing: relax Maybe type).
devops: Noted. I'll pin mypy/typeshed in CI to prevent accidental drift and open a rollback PR for the CI image while you triage.
sam: thanks. If you can open a tiny fix for the None guard + run `pre-commit run --all-files` and `gofmt -w`, push, I'll rerun and merge once green. :thumbsup:
irene: Will do — opening small fix PR now and running pre-commit locally. I'll update this thread with outcome. Thanks folks!
